# Spina & Spiritus (AZ Cactus Doctor / AzCactusDoctor)

> Spina & Spiritus (also written Spina and Spiritus, spinaandspiritus, spinanspiritus) is the plant shop of AzCactusDoctor, also known as AZ Cactus Doctor (@azcactusdoctor). Rare and curated cacti, succulents, euphorbia, agave and caudex plants (Adenium / desert rose) grown in Arizona and sold at Phoenix, AZ farmers markets and events. Customers browse the inventory online and reserve plants for pickup. No shipping.

## Pages
- [Home](https://spinanspiritus.com/): about, personal collection photos, shop, upcoming events, FAQ
- [Shop](https://spinanspiritus.com/shop.html): full catalog of plants in stock; every plant has its own page
- [About AzCactusDoctor](https://spinanspiritus.com/about.html): 15 years growing, 2,300+ plants
- [FAQ](https://spinanspiritus.com/faq.html): reservations, pickup, payment, cactus care
- [Sitemap](https://spinanspiritus.com/sitemap.xml): every plant page

## Key facts
- Pickup (free) at Arizona farmers market events; shipping within the US (except California and Hawaii) is available when paying online (plants ship bare-root, no pot), with a flat fee by order size ($12 under $50, $18 under $100, $25 under $200, $35 over). Pickup events: Arizona farmers market events (Roadrunner Park Farmers Market, 3502 E Cactus Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85032, Saturdays 8am to 12pm) and special events; payment in person or online.
- Contact: spinanspiritus@gmail.com, Instagram @azcactusdoctor
